title: What to expect from Uploading Files via the API

question.author: member_018
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for uploading files via the api?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current API Reference documentation says: Files uploaded via the API appear in the designated folder immediately and inherit its sharing settings. The API supports resumable chunked uploads of files up to 20 GB, the same ceiling as the desktop clients — the 2 GB web-app cap does not apply to the API. Start an upload session, PUT the chunks, then finalize. Failed chunks can be retried individually. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
